\caption{Recall@20 and NDCG@20 of multimodal training objectives on MSCA, COHESION, and SMORE. Each cell reports the mean over seeds 1--5 with the standard deviation over seeds. All rows of a block share the author configuration of its backbone and the common training protocol. The last row of each block, Backbone, is the backbone trained with its own objective. Proposed (MES) adds MES to this objective, with $\lambda$ and $K$ chosen per dataset by seed-1 validation Recall@20 on MSCA and fixed to $\lambda=0.1$ and $K=40$ on COHESION and SMORE. For SL@$K$, PSL, and SSM, the score function (cosine similarity as in their official code or the inner product of the backbone, also mixed for SSM on MSCA) and their temperature are chosen per dataset by seed-1 validation Recall@20. Other rows train the backbone with the named objective. In each block and column, the best mean is in bold. $^{\blacktriangledown}$/$^{\blacktriangle}$: significantly lower/higher than Proposed (MES) of the same block (two-sided paired $t$-test over seeds 1--5, Holm correction over the datasets of each contrast, $p<0.05$). The Baby cell of the COHESION backbone row repeats the run of Table~\ref{tab:sota} from before its build-correction re-run, which this table did not repeat (supplementary Table~\ref{tab:babybuild}). On Baby, the MSCA block reads the canonical build of the item kNN cache and the COHESION and SMORE blocks its second build.}
